'''Mykal''' were large batlike creatures found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that, when seen, were prone to attack. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his companions fought many of these creatures while on the [[Great Walkway]].<ref name="kotor" />

Mykal were aerial predators found in the huge, sprawling [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of Kashyyyk. They built large nests and attack almost anything that they spot. Some mykal grew to enormous size and were found only in the deepest, most ancient portions of the wilderness, but they were most common in the middle to upper canopies, which is where the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] built their treehouse cities. Mykal [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] were nutritious and tasty, and were considered a delicacy by most [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. However, acquiring them was quite a challenge, considering that mykal nests are found hundreds of meters above the forest floor.<ref name="Kotor creatures 3" />

Mykal were an important part of the Kashyyyk ecosystem since they were responsible for keeping the numbers of [[Kinrath/Legends|kinrath]] in check. Despite this, the Wookiees considered mykal pests and shot them on sight.<ref name="Kotor creatures 3" />
